newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kremlin to hold press briefing at 1200 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Kremlin to hold press briefing at 1200 GMT.

text.p: The Kremlin said on Tuesday that press spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky would hold a regular news briefing at 4 p.m. (1200 GMT), but it had no information about the topics to be discussed.

Yastrzhembsky holds regular briefings in the Kremlin. Many have dealt with the activities of President Boris Yeltsin, who is in the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow while doctors prepare the ground for heart bypass surgery.

Yeltsin, 65, met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov on Tuesday. He had two heart attacks last year and doctors have said they expect to operate on him in the next two months.
